Our name is Texasceu or Txceu and we have created this channel to share helpful and entertaining videos about the massage industry, ce classes, and how to become a successful massage therapist. We are also a division of Texas Massage Academy in Brownwood, Texas that trains massage therapists approved by TDLR license number MS1040. 

Training comes in many different names like CBT or computer-based training, CBL computer-based learning, and distance learning. Ok, you get the idea! We love what we do as a continuing education provider!

Some items you can expect by subscribing to this channel are business classes, marketing classes, ethics, networking, and pretty much anything CE related! WE cover it all! Honestly, we have courses that even someone who might not be in the massage industry can still use in their business or industry. 

We hope that you look around and explore our fun new videos and way of learning!

If you have any questions or comments, please feel free to connect us!
